step.cmd: Shift to P (Park) while the ENGINE START/STOP button is in the ON position.
Press the desired memory button (1 or 2). The system will beep once, and then the driver’s seat, outside rearview mirror height will automatically adjust to the stored positions.

stepresult.p: “Driver 1 (or 2) settings applied” will appear on the infotainment screen and instrument cluster.
